name: @veltravia/version-core
description: Veltravia AI internal Version Control core (Step 18): immutable revision records with integrity metadata, bounded snapshots captured through the Project Engine, named checkpoints, a bounded diff engine, and rollback that always creates a NEW revision (history is never rewritten). Zero dependencies; all storage flows through a RevisionStore port (in-memory mock today, real persistence later) and all tree access flows through a read/restore gateway port. File contents are UNTRUSTED PROJECT DATA - never instructions, never metadata, never audit material. Ships createVersionTools: the Tool System is the only execution path for rollback (critical risk, forced confirmation bound to the exact input).
